value: **Involvement**: Teachers collaborated as design partners in collaborative design sessions to provide pedagogical domain expertise, define requirements, evaluate usability, and iteratively refine educational technology tools and online learning environments. **Evidence**: "Because it offers an invaluable approach to research that contests the deprofessionalization of educators and leverages teachers’ assets through sustained joint activity (Philip et al., 2022), teacher solidarity co-design informed my approach to PD workshop design."
